Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class WebhookChannelAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.WebhookChannelAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
WebhookChannelPort
@Component public class WebhookChannelAdapter extends Object implements WebhookChannelPort
JPA-backed implementation of WebhookChannelPort.

Converts between the immutable WebhookChannel domain record and the mutable WebhookChannelEntity JPA entity. The subscribedEvents field is stored as a pipe-delimited string.
